helpdebug:
dosbox-x [options]

DOSBox-X version 2026.10.01 SDL2, copyright 2011-2026 The DOSBox-X Team.
DOSBox-X project maintainer: joncampbell123 (The Great Codeholio)

Based on DOSBox by the DOSBox Team (See AUTHORS file)

Debugging options:

  -debug                                  Set all logging levels to debug
  -early-debug                            Log early initialization messages in DOSBox-X (implies -console)
  -keydbg                                 Log all SDL key events
  -break-start                            Break into debugger at startup
  -console                                Show logging console (Windows builds only)
  -noconsole                              Do not show logging console (Windows debug builds only)
  -log-con                                Log CON output to a log file
  -log-int21                              Log calls to INT 21h (debug level)
  -log-fileio                             Log file I/O through INT 21h (debug level)
  -nolog                                  Do not log anything to log file
  -tests                                  Run unit tests to test the DOSBox-X code
  -print-ticks                            (Debug) Print emulator time and SDL_GetTicks()
  -force-gfx-hardware                     Force render scaler system to act as if GFX_HARDWARE
